a2aRegistry.evidence: A2A Registry returned HTTP 201, verified message/send through its A2A SDK, and recorded task_conformance passed=true

toolHive.evidence: ToolHive remote proxy initialized XGuard successfully and tools/list returned xguard_discover, xguard_resource_details, and xguard_status; compatibility run ended with TOOLHIVE_XGUARD_COMPATIBILITY=PASS; official contribution still requires a fork/PR to the external registry repository

mcpFoundry.evidence: MCP Foundry is free, open-source and accepts public MCP tool submissions through a toolbox.toml manifest in submissions/ followed by automated security scanning; XGuard is a public read-only remote MCP server and qualifies in principle, but the required external-repository fork/PR cannot be created by the currently connected GitHub app

x402scan.evidence: issue remains open with no maintainer status change; routed-gateway patch model is documented and preserves xpay signer attribution

x402Foundation.evidence: production-provider listing request sent to info@x402.org; GitHub App writes to the foundation repository are not authorized

agenticMarket.evidence: Agentic Market lists seller APIs that expose x402-paid endpoints; XGuard's facilitator safety gateway endpoints are not themselves seller resources returning x402 payment challenges

payShCatalog.evidence: pay.sh public catalog requires paid endpoints that return MPP or x402 402 challenges on supported mainnet payment rails; XGuard is facilitator-compatible infrastructure rather than a paid seller endpoint

ampersendMarketplace.evidence: Ampersend marketplace is for pay-per-use API services consumed by agent wallets; XGuard's verify/settle gateway is not a marketplace seller endpoint

publicMcp.evidence: PUBLICMCP requires its business-profile MCP tool contract including get_info, get_services and get_location; XGuard exposes xguard_discover, xguard_resource_details and xguard_status instead

x402Scout.evidence: registry requires an x402-gated endpoint with provider wallet and auth_required=false; XGuard verify/settle use API key plus prepaid service balance, so registering there would be inaccurate

index402.evidence: 402 Index self-registration verifies a paid endpoint that directly returns protocol payment challenges; XGuard is a facilitator safety gateway rather than a directly x402-gated resource
